row.evidence: Cognism's help centre documents Okta SCIM ("Create Users, Deactivate Users, Reactivate Users") while its Entra guide says "Full SCIM user provisioning and automatic deprovisioning are not currently supported"; both plans (Standard, Pro) are Talk to sales.
row.notes: Quote-only: Standard and Pro (5 seats included each) have no public prices ('Talk to sales'); the pricing page marks SSO on both, and no plan gate for SCIM is stated, so the lowest plan is assumed to be Standard. SCIM works with Okta only (OIN app: SAML + SCIM Create/Update/Deactivate); Entra ID, and any other SAML IdP, is JIT-only with no automatic deprovisioning, which would otherwise make this partial. The Okta SCIM token is a Cognism API token valid six months. Deactivated users stay in Cognism as inactive. No user-management API is documented (the public API is for B2B data).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: SSO is checked for both Standard and Pro (read from page markup).

auth.token_source: Cognism Settings > Tokens / API > Create new token (Admin only)

endpoints.notes: Users only via the Okta app; no group features listed.

operations.notes: Okta enables Update user attributes, but changing a user's email in Okta does not update it in Cognism.

deprovision.data_retained: Users deactivated in Okta remain in Cognism as inactive users.

attributes.notes: Email is the unique identifier; no other attribute list published.

limitations.text: SCIM works only with Okta; Entra ID is JIT-only with no SCIM or automatic deprovisioning.
Email changes in Okta are not pushed to Cognism; email is the unique identifier.
New users are created only if licences are available.
Okta app is IdP-initiated; SP-initiated login needs a second Okta app.

scim.notes: SCIM is documented only through the Okta OIN Cognism app; no generic SCIM base URL or endpoint reference is published. The Okta guide sets up SSO first and provisioned users authenticate only through SSO, so SSO is treated as a prerequisite. Plan inferred: the pricing page lists SSO on both Standard and Pro and does not name a SCIM tier.

limitations.text: Public API is a data API (search/enrich contacts and companies), not a user-management API.

user_api.notes: The public Cognism API (developers.cognism.com) covers search, redeem, enrich, entitlement, filter and compliance endpoints for B2B data only; no user-management endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: OIN app has SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Microsoft Learn SSO tutorial; JIT only.

google.notes: Google is supported only as social login, which does not count as SSO.

fallbacks.notes: Custom SAML with Entra, Okta or other SAML 2.0 IdPs; JIT creates users on first sign-in. Users are invited and deleted manually in User management.
